scenes.title: A hall that can read anything
scenes.want: Make fine writing legible without damaging it
scenes.obstacle: Messages arrive in many fragile forms; reading a mark does not identify its use
scenes.entry: The hall appears practised and orderly
scenes.tactic: Attend to the silk through the crystal
scenes.decision: Stay with the small exact work rather than perform mastery for the room
scenes.turn: Impressive reading skill established → audience is ready to mistake skill for judgement
scenes.stakes: A system with wide reach can spread a small error
scenes.emotion: Confidence with a trace of vulnerability
scenes.ethical: Does the ability to read oblige the reader to act?
scenes.physical: Preserve the accepted wide illustration; crystal/silk held steady
scenes.sound: Quiet work; no invented ceremonial music
scenes.exit: Legible marks; an unanswered question about who sent them
scenes.link: The unidentifiable river tablet tests the hall’s apparent competence

scenes.title: The honest absence
scenes.want: Deliver the found tablet without claiming knowledge he lacks
scenes.obstacle: The tablet arrives without a usable sender or recipient; court attention can make uncertainty feel like failure
scenes.entry: A courier has an object but no trustworthy route back to its author
scenes.tactic: Present the object; decline to fill the missing knowledge with a guess
scenes.decision: [PROPOSAL SR01] After the tablet rests on the surface, keep the empty hand open briefly when attention seeks an absent seal
scenes.turn: An object arrives → its origin and destination remain explicitly unknown
scenes.stakes: An honest limitation can be discarded when the object passes to someone powerful
scenes.ethical: Who is permitted to say that they do not know?
scenes.prop: one found tablet; dissolved seal trace
scenes.physical: [PROPOSAL] A later released/empty-hand pose needs approval; accepted held art alone cannot perform it
scenes.sound: Let the existing narration state the unknowns; no new courier speech
scenes.exit: One tablet on the intake surface; no invented authentic seal
scenes.link: Tahmures asks a question without assigning the object a present role
scenes.costume: Chapar brown/cream; distinct from white-haired messenger

scenes.title: A question with three doors
scenes.want: Receive a useful description of the object
scenes.obstacle: He assumes his desired kind of answer is shared
scenes.entry: One unidentified object and three capable readers
scenes.tactic: Ask a short royal question; let each specialist inspect
scenes.turn: A common object is offered → three incompatible assignments become possible
scenes.stakes: The ruler’s expectation is not yet a shared constraint
scenes.ethical: Does obedience relieve the questioner of responsibility for the question?
scenes.physical: Read marks, inspect weight/cord, and read twice in succession; never duplicate the tablet
scenes.sound: Retain exact D-S03-1; avoid ominous villain scoring
scenes.exit: Black Div has read; the hall has not agreed what kind of answer is wanted
scenes.link: Each reader’s expertise supplies its own answer and action

scenes.title: Competence becomes commitment
scenes.want: Each completes the work they recognise
scenes.obstacle: The same sentence can be a historical record, an urgent dispatch or a current order
scenes.entry: No mutually stated role for the tablet
scenes.decision: Messenger takes the supported packet; Black Div leaves without it
scenes.turn: Three interpretations coexist → they acquire independent physical consequences
scenes.stakes: A trip cannot be unmade once taken; a message can outrun its uncertainty
scenes.ethical: Which reasonable precaution becomes unreasonable when its premise is unstated?
scenes.prop: catalogue distinct from tablet; oilcloth packet
scenes.physical: Use the existing supported messenger pose; do not invent a wrapping transformation or new gait
scenes.sound: Keep exact Akvan/Div-e Sefid recordings. Their certainty should differ, not become evil
scenes.exit: Packet with messenger; Black Div empty-handed beyond the room
scenes.link: A correct numerical answer returns attached to a bodily cost
scenes.costume: Akvan blue-toned/dark-gold; messenger pale/white-haired; Black Div dark

scenes.title: The right answer costs a journey
scenes.want: Report faithfully / recover a shared meaning
scenes.obstacle: Every existing reply is defensible but fails to undo the crossing
scenes.entry: Black Div returns wet, without the tablet
scenes.tactic: Give a precise count; answer the actual objections without mockery
scenes.decision: [PROPOSAL SR02] Tahmures looks at the wet clothing before acknowledging the unanticipated cost without yet diagnosing the request defect
scenes.turn: King seeks an error in the answer → king recognises the unanticipated cost without yet diagnosing its cause
scenes.stakes: Wet crossing and elapsed time already spent; the court cannot refund them
scenes.ethical: Can the ruler accept an answer and still admit the harm?
scenes.prop: wet empty hands/clothing; no river tablet
scenes.physical: Hold the body/cloth evidence; do not add wound, collapse or new weather
scenes.sound: Five original dialogue cues retained; new king cost acknowledgement is a separate unrecorded line; he has not yet diagnosed the request defect
scenes.exit: [PROPOSAL] The king has no rebuttal ready; the wet reader remains a person, not a lesson prop
scenes.link: The cost expands from one body/journey to a public false alarm

scenes.title: The hall’s error travels
scenes.want: Protect the frontier before an apparent threat arrives
scenes.obstacle: The courier chain makes urgency visible while hiding uncertainty
scenes.entry: Messenger packet reaches Arash before dispatch
scenes.tactic: Dispatch riders; villages respond; charcoal burners continue ordinary work
scenes.decision: Preserve delivery-before-dispatch and show the real camp separately
scenes.turn: Apparent invasion → eleven ordinary charcoal fires; fear is real though the threat is not
scenes.stakes: Three villages lose a quiet night; riders and Black Div spend unrecoverable effort
scenes.emotion: Escalation → recontextualisation, not a comic erasure of cost
scenes.ethical: What remains owed after an alarm proves false?
scenes.prop: one packet with Arash; lamps; exactly eleven charcoal fires
scenes.physical: Three distinct village settings; workers/tools clear of fire; no attack or burning home
scenes.sound: Use existing narration; suggested local ambience changes are PROPOSAL, not existing recorded effects
scenes.exit: The fires are ordinary; consequences of naming them a threat remain
scenes.link: The king initially tries more words, not a different responsibility
scenes.costume: Arash separate from anonymous riders and villagers

scenes.title: The pen that need not continue
scenes.focal: Akvan and Shahrasp against Tahmures’s first remedy
scenes.obstacle: More wording preserves the undefined demand for meaning
scenes.entry: King dictates a longer version of the same uncertainty
scenes.tactic: Akvan interrupts the premise; Shahrasp stops rather than embellishes
scenes.decision: [PROPOSAL SR03] Akvan’s economical counterline earns the stop; keep the separate labels/card demonstration
scenes.turn: Length mistaken for repair → a requested result and missing context become visible
scenes.stakes: The court must surrender a polished answer and admit three unknowns
scenes.ethical: May a subordinate prevent a more eloquent mistake?
scenes.prop: reed; ledger; four labels; separate request card
scenes.physical: No new knife; stop once; exact labels added locally; old tablet packet does not teleport back
scenes.sound: D-S07-1 kept; D-S07-2 replacement requires approval/new recording; use speech-free source gaps only as measured capacity, not guaranteed silence
scenes.exit: Four distinct places; first three unknown; request card separated from examined words
scenes.link: Demonstration tests roles beyond this one embarrassing case
scenes.costume: Akvan’s gesture/expression requires her own approved pose

scenes.title: The same words change work
scenes.want: Show what a sentence does in three settings
scenes.entry: One sentence is ready to be mistaken for one role
scenes.tactic: Compare current order, quoted evidence and handwriting practice
scenes.decision: Keep the apprentice anonymous and the scenes illustrative
scenes.turn: A single grammatical form → several contextual functions
scenes.stakes: A rule must survive beyond one selected example
scenes.ethical: Who gives words their present work?
scenes.prop: gate order; evidence document; practice sheet all distinct from river tablet
scenes.physical: No gate reaction to quoted/practice words
scenes.sound: Retain original two narration cues; exact phrase is local text
scenes.exit: Ink remains ink in the practice vignette
scenes.link: S09 explicitly translates the dramatic distinction into modern engineering

scenes.title: The engineering bridge
scenes.want: Transfer the distinction to the complete model interaction
scenes.obstacle: A single memorable sentence can eclipse the surrounding system
scenes.entry: Ancient example has shown consequences and a repair
scenes.decision: Retain exact bridge content as a separate explanatory register
scenes.turn: A story about one tablet → a model of a structured request
scenes.stakes: Reader must not infer that better prose authenticates or enforces permission
scenes.ethical: What must deterministic application code still enforce?
scenes.prop: native editable envelope graphic; no royal seal as security proof
scenes.physical: No AI-generated text; keep source formula and eight components
scenes.sound: All three approved narration cues retained
scenes.exit: One testable review question returns the audience to action
scenes.link: The corrected northbound message demonstrates a concrete next decision
scenes.source: From Tale to Engineering / Mental Model
scenes.costume: No ancient character delivers modern jargon

scenes.title: A correction carries a name
scenes.want: Correct the rumour and receive acknowledgement
scenes.obstacle: A shorter message can still evade who owns the first alarm
scenes.entry: A better-defined request has been prepared
scenes.tactic: Name recipient, correct the rumour, ask for acknowledgement
scenes.decision: [PROPOSAL SR04] Add the local visible correction inscription “The alarm began in this hall.”
scenes.turn: The king’s authority sent alarm outward → it now carries responsibility outward
scenes.stakes: Repair does not erase the spent night or guarantee trust restored
scenes.ethical: Can a correction take responsibility without creating another spectacle?
scenes.prop: new correction message, not duplicated river tablet
scenes.physical: Use reviewed presentation/handoff pose only; overlay exact inscription locally
scenes.sound: No new speech; retain three narrator cues, natural pacing unchanged unless picture review demands time
scenes.exit: Riders return; villagers lower the same lamps
scenes.link: The ledger retains the lesson; an incomplete treaty tests its limits
scenes.costume: Div-e Sefid receives correction; Chapar not substituted

scenes.title: A practice, not a victory
scenes.focal: Shahrasp, then Akvan / Div-e Sefid in proposed coda
scenes.want: Keep a record of what changed without pretending uncertainty has ended
scenes.obstacle: A neat maxim can close a question that the next case reopens
scenes.entry: Correction has returned riders; ledger remains
scenes.tactic: Keep the existing closing sentence, then contrast a document whose middle is absent
scenes.decision: [PROPOSAL SR05] Attach a brief canonical-hook coda within S11 before the final series mark; no twelfth narrative scene
scenes.turn: A named role seems sufficient → missing evidence becomes the next unresolved problem
scenes.stakes: Div-e Sefid’s confidence must not become proof of promises no one can read
scenes.ethical: Who can speak for words that are no longer there?
scenes.prop: ledger/reed; candidate damp-damaged treaty, not river tablet
scenes.physical: New treaty/reference/pose missing; do not fabricate missing promises as readable text
scenes.sound: Existing NEN-11 retained; proposed hook narration and coda duration TBD
scenes.exit: Reed begins before anyone asks for evidence; cut before any missing promise is endorsed
scenes.link: Chapter 02 uncertainty hook; messenger/Mirror role transition requires owner approval
scenes.costume: Same named Div-e Sefid; no invented identity merger beyond the scoped proposal
